name: PredBench
description: In this paper, we introduce PredBench, a benchmark tailored for the holistic evaluation of spatio-temporal prediction networks. Despite significant progress in this field, there remains a lack of a standardized framework for a detailed and comparative analysis of various prediction network architectures. PredBench addresses this gap by conducting large-scale experiments, upholding standardized and appropriate experimental settings, and implementing multi-dimensional evaluations. This benchmark integrates 12 widely adopted methods with 15 diverse datasets across multiple application domains, offering extensive evaluation of contemporary spatio-temporal prediction networks. Through meticulous calibration of prediction settings across various applications, PredBench ensures evaluations relevant to their intended use and enables fair comparisons. Moreover, its multi-dimensional evaluation framework broadens the analysis with a comprehensive set of metrics, providing deep insights into the capabilities of models. The findings from our research offer strategic directions for future developments in the field. Our codebase is available at https://github.com/OpenEarthLab/PredBench.
evaluation_method: regression and perceptual metrics (MAE/RMSE and SSIM/PSNR depending on dataset)
general_score_metric: MAE / RMSE (task-dependent), supplemented by SSIM for perceptual quality
reputation: Research-oriented benchmark gaining attention for systematic, multi-dataset evaluation of spatio-temporal prediction models.
notes: Heterogeneous multi-dataset benchmark — metrics and SOTA vary by dataset, forecasting horizon, and spatial resolution; not an LLM benchmark; comparisons sensitive to preprocessing and evaluation protocols.
